site_description: PrexorLabs makes small, free Minecraft mods. A lab for a better Minecraft.
home_title: A lab for a better Minecraft.
home_intro: Small, free mods for the parts of the game that get in your way. Numbered like experiments, built in the open.
shot_list: ServerListPlus in the multiplayer screen: folder tabs, a pinned server and a divider
shot_search: Searching the server list for folder:minigames
slp_text: Folders, search and notes for the multiplayer screen.

privacy_intro: This site works without cookies, tracking or analytics and loads nothing from other servers. What still happens when you open it is listed here.
privacy_controller_text: The provider named in the imprint.
privacy_hosting_text: The site is delivered by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. To send you a page, Cloudflare has to process your IP address and the details of the request, such as the address of the page and your browser. This is needed to run the site and to protect it from attacks (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). PrexorLabs does not keep logs of these requests. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacy_storage_text: If you switch between the light and the dark theme, your browser remembers the choice in its local storage. It stays on your device and is never sent to anyone. You can delete it in your browser's site settings.
privacy_links_text: Links to Discord and GitHub lead to sites of their own. Their privacy policies apply once you follow such a link.
privacy_mail_text: If you write to us, your address and message are used to answer you and are deleted once the matter is settled.
privacy_rights_text: You can ask what data about you is stored, have it corrected or deleted, restrict its processing and object to it. You can also complain to a data protection authority.
projects_intro: Each project starts as a numbered experiment and gets a name once it works. All of them are free and open source.
next_page_text: It gets a name and a page once it works. Discord hears first.
idea_text: Missing something in Minecraft? Post it in #ideas. An idea that gets picked up comes back here with a number.
slp_tagline: The multiplayer server list, finally manageable. Folders as tabs, search with filters, sorting, pinning, notes, tags and playtime, all in your game.
slp_meta: Minecraft {from} to {to} · Fabric and NeoForge · MIT · on GitHub now, Modrinth and CurseForge follow
tour_label: A tour of the server list
tour_overview_caption: The multiplayer screen with ServerListPlus. Nothing outside it changes.
tour_overview_alt: The whole multiplayer screen with ServerListPlus
tour_folders_caption: Folders as tabs, each with its count. + adds one, and tabs reorder by dragging.
tour_pins_caption: A pinned server stays on top. Last join and total playtime sit next to its name.
tour_pins_alt: Close-up of a pinned server with its last join and playtime
tour_dividers_caption: Dividers group servers within a tab. Double click one to rename it.
tour_players_caption: Players and ping, refreshed on their own at an interval you choose.
tour_players_alt: Close-up of player counts and ping
tour_search_caption: Search, sorting and settings. Ctrl + F opens the search.
tour_search_alt: Close-up of the search, sort and settings buttons
feature_folders_text: "All" plus one tab per folder, as a row or a sidebar. Smart folders fill themselves from a search.
feature_search_text: Filters for tags, folders, notes, ping, players and playtime. Sort by name, ping, players or last played, or by hand.
feature_bulk_text: Select several servers to move, pin, hide or file them at once. Dividers group servers within a tab.
feature_notes_text: Per server, with an optional reminder of the notes when you join it.
feature_direct_text: See the typed server before you join, and keep the shown servers refreshed on their own.
feature_style_text: MiniMessage colours in server names, plus colours, symbols and backgrounds per tab.
slp_search_text: All terms must match. Case and Minecraft colour codes are ignored. A saved search becomes a smart folder that fills itself.
slp_search_hint: Ctrl + F opens the search in the game.
term_word: name, address, MOTD or notes contain the word
term_online: the last ping reached the server; also is:offline
term_ping: compares ping; players:>10 compares online players
term_played: compares total playtime; played:0 finds servers never played
term_last: last joined less than 7 days ago
install_loader: Install Fabric with the Fabric API, or NeoForge.
install_download: Download the jar for your Minecraft version and loader.
install_mods: Put it into the {folder} folder of your instance.
notes_120_select: Select several servers and drag, pin, hide or file them together.
notes_120_tabs: Reorder tabs by dragging; the sidebar can hide itself.
notes_120_update: An update hint when Modrinth has a newer release.
notes_120_thanks: Multi-select, tab reordering and the sidebar rework by FllipEis.
notes_111_logo: Launchers and mod lists show the ServerListPlus logo instead of a placeholder.
notes_110_symbol: A note symbol next to servers with notes: hover to read, click to edit.
notes_110_reminder: An optional reminder of the notes when joining a server.
notes_110_filters: New filters note:, has:, is:online, is:offline, played: and last:.
notes_100_folders: Folders as tabs or a sidebar, smart folders, search and sorting.
notes_100_pins: Pins, dividers, notes, tags, last join and playtime.
notes_100_direct: Direct Connection preview, automatic status refresh, English and German.
slp_data_file: Everything ServerListPlus adds is stored in {file}. Your {vanilla} only changes the way it would without the mod, so removing it leaves your list as it was.
slp_data_update: When the game starts, the mod asks Modrinth whether a newer release exists for your Minecraft version and loader. Nothing else is sent, and the check can be turned off in the settings.
slp_data_help: Bugs and ideas go to #help on Discord or to the issues on GitHub. A screenshot and your latest.log help most.
